scientific_question: Can a small geometry-only selector choose a safe five-of-nine camera subset for a held-out reported calibration after the finite H1 family was shown to contain calibration-shared witnesses?
role: post-open leave-one-calibration-out development diagnostic; not fresh external evidence, not a field reconstructor, not a resource result, and not real BOST
physical_hypothesis: The v169 selector discarded orientation information by reducing the low-frequency H1-whitened geometry Gram to four scalar summaries. A shared linear ranker over the Gram in a fixed world-DCT coordinate system may learn which observable low-frequency mode couplings predict a safe H1 subset without reading held-out truth.

outer_split.scheme: leave one complete reported calibration out
outer_split.heldout_truth_rule: the held-out calibration candidate metrics are absent from the fold package and may be opened only by the scoring stage after the prediction tree is sealed
outer_split.scope_boundary: all calibration outcomes were already opened by v170, so this is post-open development evidence even though the v171 computation is fail-closed and fold-isolated

strict_fit_target.definition: log of the maximum candidate metric divided by its frozen p90 limit over all nine fields, four times, and three metrics within one calibration
strict_fit_target.strict_local_safe: target risk <= 1.0; this is stronger than the final global p90-higher budget
strict_fit_target.truth_use: fit-calibration v170 candidate metrics only; no held-out calibration metric enters fitting, normalization, feature construction, selection, tie-break, or fallback

geometry_feature.construction: for each candidate, form the 26-mode H1-whitened Gram in the fixed world-DCT coordinates using only reported geometry and the frozen straight-ray operator
geometry_feature.matrix_coordinates: trace-normalized symmetric Gram upper triangle with off-diagonal entries multiplied by sqrt(2), followed by log trace, mean log eigenvalue, log minimum eigenvalue, log maximum eigenvalue, and log condition number
geometry_feature.camera_permutation: canonicalize the nine records by the exact finite tuple used by v169-v170; reversing input records must preserve every feature and selected physical camera set

primary_selector.name: LOCO Gram-Ridge Risk Ranker
primary_selector.model: one shared linear ridge regressor with an unpenalized intercept
primary_selector.feature_standardization: fit rows only; retain columns with population standard deviation greater than 1e-12
primary_selector.selection: minimum predicted log risk among the 126 candidates; exact ties choose the lowest lexicographic subset index

cheap_controls.v169_fixed_geometry: the independently frozen low-frequency rank/log-pseudodeterminant/minimum-eigenvalue/trace lexicographic selector
cheap_controls.fit_static_subset: within each outer fold, choose one canonical subset index minimizing the worst strict risk over the twelve fit calibrations; ties use mean risk then subset index
cheap_controls.control_rule: if either cheaper control satisfies the same strict-local and global gates, v171 cannot claim learned-selector advantage

prediction_barrier.fold_package: contains all geometry features and only the twelve fit-calibration risk rows for that fold

final_gate.control_dominance: both cheap controls receive the identical 13-of-13 strict-local and four-stratum global gate

cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden; no fresh-process wall or whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.feature_operator: independent camera-ray, sparse-operator, and analytic DCT implementation
independent_recomputation.ridge_solver: augmented least-squares solve rather than formal normal-equation solve

decision_order: Any parent, fold-isolation, feature, prediction-seal, mutation, numeric, score, accounting, or independent-recomputation failure makes v171 inconclusive.
If the primary does not select a strict-local-safe subset in all thirteen folds or fails any global stratum, conclude FAIL_RESULT_BLIND_GEOMETRY_SELECTOR_V171 and close this Gram-ridge selector.
If the primary passes but either cheap control also passes, conclude FAIL_CHEAP_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_SELECTOR_V171 and do not claim learned advantage.
Only if the primary passes, both controls fail, and independent recomputation agrees may v171 conclude PASS_RESULT_BLIND_GEOMETRY_SELECTOR_HEADROOM_V171.

A pass remains post-open controlled virtual-proxy evidence and only authorizes a separately frozen field/time generalization gate; it is not algorithm breakthrough, speed, external generalization, or real BOST.
